# infrawrench_permissions (Data Source)

Every permission string this installation understands — the catalogue `infrawrench_role` and `infrawrench_api_key` grant from.

The list grows with each release, so reading it beats hard-coding one that will quietly go stale. Note the direction of that staleness: a role written with an explicit list does **not** pick up permissions added later, which is usually what you want for a least-privilege role and is exactly what wildcards exist to opt out of.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. A plural data source has no identity of its own; this is the conventional placeholder.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission strings, e.g. `costs:read`, in the order the API returned them.
